errors.text: The response provides no additive-manufacturing strategy or post-processing route.
It fails to identify the hydride-containing HfNbTaTiZr ink, extrusion printing, hydrogen de-binding, vacuum sintering, or quenching route.
It proposes no microstructural target, missing the metastable single beta-BCC state with controlled oxygen content.
It supplies neither a predicted performance outcome nor a falsifiable experiment.
